title: Industrial Automation Programming Environment — Overview and definition
t: Industrial Automation Programming Environment — Overview and definition
description: Programs PLCs, robots, and motion controllers with IEC 61131-3 languages and simulation.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Programs PLCs, robots, and motion controllers with IEC 61131-3 languages and simulation. An industrial automation programming environment edits ladder logic, structured text, function blocks, and sequential function charts for controllers, with tag databases and HMI screen design. Real implementations include CODESYS, Siemens TIA Portal, and Rockwell Studio 5000. It offers offline simulation, online monitoring, and versioned downloads to controllers.

title: Industrial Automation Programming Environment — Teaching-ladder exercise
t: Industrial Automation Programming Environment — Teaching-ladder exercise
description: Programs PLCs, robots, and motion controllers with IEC 61131-3 languages and simulation.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Teaching ladder for Industrial Automation Programming Environment, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (IEC 61131-3 editors: LD, ST, FBD, SFC, IL). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: IEC 61131-3 editors: LD, ST, FBD, SFC, IL and Tag database with symbolic addressing and data-type checking. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) simulator) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
